title: Drafter, human review with feedback, revise loop, companion reply

turns.question: Draft a reply to a customer whose shipment is delayed by a week.
turns.note: Stops at Review Gate; Companion replies in parallel

humanInput.feedback: Please mention the 10% discount code SORRY10.

turns.note: Reject with feedback: loops back to Drafter and stops again

turns.question: Now draft a short SMS version of that message.
turns.note: Normal question: stops at Review Gate again

reply.content: Draft: Dear customer, we are sorry that your shipment is delayed by a week. It will arrive next Friday.
Draft v2: Dear customer, we are sorry for the one-week delay. Please use code SORRY10 for 10% off your next order.
Draft SMS: Sorry for the delay! Your order arrives Friday. Use SORRY10 for 10% off.
Final: Dear customer, we apologise for the one-week delay. Your order arrives next Friday, and code SORRY10 gives you 10% off your next order.
Final SMS: Sorry for the delay! Your order arrives Friday. Use SORRY10 for 10% off.

expectedAfter.F05: The answer becomes the user message of the resume turn: t2 'Please mention the 10% discount code SORRY10.', t3 'Approve' (button label), t5 'Approved, send it.'
expectedAfter.F07: History alternates user/assistant: the resume reply follows the saved answer instead of the stopped turn's bot message.
expectedAfter.F08: No action JSON inside history messages; pending resume data lives in its own token field while stopped.
expectedAfter.F09: Resume turns do not copy the previous turn's records; the token does not grow across t1 -> t2 -> t3.
expectedAfter.F19: The action event carries only id, mapping, elements, data.nodeId, data.nodeLabel and data.input.humanInputEnableFeedback.
